conditions.instruction: Pick up the object resting on the table.

conditions.rgb: centered rectangle, floor(0.15*width) by floor(0.15*height), RGB [127,127,127]

ablation: After strict full checkpoint load, set action_header.psi01.specs=(). This disables additive bias, augmented QK terms and query-dependent relation logits in every RelJointAttnProcessor; retain morphology tokens, their learned gates and all trained weights. Inference-dependence diagnostic, not a retrained ablation or restored BC.
judge: Unchanged SIMPLE privileged success predicate, task hooks and TimeLimit; judge never passed to learned policy.
analysis: Report all outcomes and paired counts by config and condition; no checkpoint/condition selection from results. Small development diagnostic, no population superiority claim. Public40k is deployment reference, localBC10k is training-matched control.
limitations: Generic grasp task has no validated multi-stage or referential-language judge. Paraphrase robustness is not compositional understanding. RGB mask is image-coordinate fixed, never object-truth-targeted. Ideal proprioception and native tracker unchanged.

runtime_budget.optional_admission: Only start optional arm if core completes within5400seconds and compute admission remains available; never select based on outcomes.
runtime_budget.nominal_rerun_reason: Fresh nominal establishes matched source snapshot, recorder and runtime across arms; original historical pilot and current public2episode clips use different recording protocols.
